title: SB 735 (2021-2022 Regular Session): A Joint Resolution proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, further providing for qualifications of electors.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Section 1, Art. VII § 1(b)1
(quote) 1. When voting in person, the qualified elector shall present a valid identification before receiving a ballot to vote in person.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Section 1, Art. VII § 1(b)2
(quote) 2. When not voting in person, the qualified elector shall provide a copy PROOF of a valid identification with his or her ballot.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Section 1, Art. VII § 1(c) and definition
(quote) (c) Notwithstanding any law regarding the types of valid identifications necessary for a qualified elector to comply with subsection (b), valid identifications shall include, but not be limited to, a valid government-issued identification. FOR PURPOSES OF THIS SECTION, THE TERM "VALID IDENTIFICATION" MEANS ANY VALID GOVERNMENT-ISSUED IDENTIFICATION, UNLESS OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR BY LAW.
(other) Section 1 also lowers the voting age text from 21 to 18 in § 1(a) (shown as bracketed deletion).
(other) Section 2: advertising and submission to voters.
